program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load / 2nd stage L (shared -> no systematic offset)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS load / M7 gm/Id
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS mirror L (bias, tail, M8)
    "gmidn": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 40e-6),
    "I7":    (60e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6),
    "Cc":    (2.1e-12, 1.0e-12, 4e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = kRz / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Itail, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    # NMOS bias mirror family (same L, gm/Id -> current-density matched)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and 2nd-stage device (same gm/Id, L)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Itail / 2, vds=0.75)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)     # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "n2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)     # output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n2", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n2", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n2", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + Cc * cl) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2))
    # mirror pole contribution
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir)) / 2
    swing = 1.62 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.15
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2 * (8 / 3) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = vn_th * 6  # rough flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A1 * A2), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "swing": swing,
               "slew": slew, "noise_1k": noise}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc compensation)
